name: context-guard
description: Context + cost on the status line; checkpoint nudge at the soft limit; denies starting new work past the hard limit.

soft.title: Soft limit (%)
soft.description: Context fill (whole %) at which to nudge a NOTES.md checkpoint.

hard.title: Hard limit (%)
hard.description: Context fill (whole %) past which new work (Agent, lane launches) is denied.
